moduleEmailsDescription: Operational bodies for booking and rent notification and confirmation emails. These are not campaign templates.
bookingNotifyPurpose: Notify the team about a new booking request
bookingCanceledPurpose: Tell the client that the booking was canceled
rentNotifyPurpose: Notify the team about a new rental request
rentConfirmPurpose: Confirm an accepted rental request to the client
rentDeclinedPurpose: Tell the client that the rental request was declined
customValuesHint: Custom form values are also available by their field ID when the request includes them.
guideDescription: Use these files to keep repeatable email work fast and predictable.
templatesGuide: Templates can be plain HTML or JavaScript files. A JavaScript template should export a function that receives the payload object and returns HTML.
componentsGuide: Components are reusable HTML snippets for headers, footers, buttons or legal text. Add them to templates when you want the same block across multiple emails.
attachmentsGuide: Asset attachments are reusable files stored for future campaigns. They are not added automatically. Select them in the Builder when you send, or reference text/base64 assets inside templates and components with {{ASSET:filename}}. For logos or banners, store a complete data URL or hosted image URL as the attachment content and use it in an image src.
